limits: z3 is a decision procedure for bit-vectors, trusted as such; exhaustive evaluation covers every input of the narrower outputs; values stay inside a 40-bit two's-complement window
name: W12_constraints_agree

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-12

statement: Every LR35902 output term (1075: register updates, bus-effect arguments and guards) compiles to gates of degree at most 2 over the Goldilocks field (20608 gates in all), and the constraints agree with the terms on every input: z3 proves it for all of them ({'unsat': 1075}), and exhaustive evaluation confirms it wherever the inputs have at most 16 bits ({'pass': 948, 'too_wide': 127}; 33,912,934 inputs).
